gaps.label: Rule 2(1)(wa)
gaps.statement: The final also inserts Rule 2(1)(ca) defining audio/visual information. Scope is not an exemption from other applicable law.

gaps.label: Rule 2(1)(wa) proviso
gaps.statement: Read all three limbs: material distortion, false records and material manipulation remain limiting conditions.

gaps.label: Rule 2(1A)
gaps.statement: The qualifying context and underlying applicable law still matter.

gaps.label: Rule 2(1B)
gaps.statement: Do not treat this limited clarification as removing all other safe-harbour conditions or legal remedies.

gaps.label: Rule 3(1)(c), (ca), (cb)
gaps.statement: This is prior-law-to-amended-law context, not an October draft proposal. The two English criminal-law citations were later corrected; identity disclosure is expressly subject to applicable law.

gaps.label: Rule 3(1)(d)
gaps.statement: The October draft did not propose this change. Read the underlying court/government actual-knowledge conditions; not every complaint starts this clock.

gaps.label: Rule 3(2)
gaps.statement: These substitutions were absent from the October draft. The two-hour category retains the underlying complaint-content requirements; acknowledgement remains a separate matter.

gaps.label: Rule 3(3)(a)(i)
gaps.statement: The duties are tied to the final definition and applicable-law context. This desk does not decide whether a particular tool is an intermediary or a particular item is unlawful.

gaps.label: Rule 3(3)(a)(ii)
gaps.statement: This obligation applies through the defined SGI and covered-service conditions, not every edited asset.

gaps.label: Rule 3(3)(a)(ii), (b)
gaps.statement: The no-removal limb is retained in revised wording. Metadata does not by itself prove that a depicted event is true.
